title: Field Trip Incident Report Form
subtitle: An original operational incident report for field trip that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Field Trip Incident Report Form supports the complete field trip workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Field Trip Incident Report Form when the assigned trip lead needs one fillable record for trip participant, itinerary, transport, supervision, and return without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Field trip incident report identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this incident report to one trip participant, itinerary, transport, supervision, and return record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

blocks.label: Field trip record reference
blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.label: Participant and responsible route
blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

blocks.label: Field trip scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

fields.label: Scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

sections.title: Field trip incident facts and immediate condition
sections.guidance: Record direct observations, reported information, exact times, and unknowns without blame or diagnosis.

blocks.label: Field trip incident indicators
items: Student separated from assigned group
Transportation delay, route change, or vehicle issue
Illness, injury, allergic concern, or medical response
Behavioral or supervision event requiring support
Destination, weather, or activity hazard
Lost, damaged, or restricted student property
Unauthorized contact or release concern
Headcount, roster, permission, or documentation discrepancy

blocks.label: Event time, location, and information source
Chronological facts, exact words when necessary, source of each fact, unknowns, and observed impact

fields.label: Chronological facts, exact words, source, unknowns, and observed impact

blocks.label: Response and record boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records a field-trip workflow; it does not replace guardian permission, qualified medical direction, transportation rules, emergency services, or local supervision requirements. Stop movement or release when identity, headcount, authorization, health support, or safety cannot be confirmed. Share only minimum necessary information and route decisions to the authorized reviewer.

sections.title: Field trip people, property, records, and evidence
sections.guidance: Collect only information needed for response and follow-up; use approved restricted storage.

blocks.label: Property, system, document, or evidence references
Conflicting reports, missing records, unavailable evidence, privacy limits, and unresolved facts

fields.label: Conflicting reports, missing evidence, privacy limits, and unresolved facts

sections.title: Field trip response, notification, and operating decision
sections.guidance: Document the action actually taken, why it was selected, who authorized it, and what remains unresolved.

blocks.label: Immediate actions and safeguards
items: Stopped or limited the affected field trip activity, movement, or release
Protected the child, participant, volunteer, or affected person from further exposure
Used emergency services or the qualified response route when indicated
Reconciled identity, roster, headcount, item, or custody status
Notified the assigned trip lead and authorized guardian-facing route
Preserved objective facts and minimum-necessary evidence
Protected private records and restricted sensitive information
Established a temporary field trip control and accountable follow-up owner

blocks.label: Field trip incident operating decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the program administrator, guardian, and qualified health or emergency reviewer.

sections.title: Field trip review, exception ownership, and corrective follow-up
sections.guidance: Preserve questions as questions and assign evidence, correction, and recipient follow-up.

blocks.label: Open question, action, owner, due point, and review
Reviewer observations, corrections to the initial record, limitations, and rationale for final disposition

fields.label: Reviewer observations, corrections, limitations, and disposition rationale

blocks.label: Incident exception and escalation indicators
items: Trip cannot start under the documented plan
Student participation status needs guardian or administrator review
Transport, destination, or supervision arrangement changed
Health, allergy, medication, or support plan cannot be followed
Emergency, missing-student, or immediate safety response is active
Return, authorized release, or final headcount remains unresolved

sections.title: Field trip outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Field trip closeout controls
items: Final headcount and roster status accepted
Guardian or school return communication recorded
Unresolved incident or support need has an owner
Equipment and private records returned to approved custody
Transport or destination follow-up reference linked
Trip record stored with access and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Incident Report closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
